title: Column schedule
description: What the engineer's drawing says one column must be. Filled by the schedule form or from an uploaded PDF, always confirmed by a person before a check runs. Read by concrete_evidence/check.py and codes.py.

element.description: Column mark on the drawing, e.g. "C1" or "P-12"

column_mm.description: Cross-section b × h in mm. Needed for the Eurocode limits

cover_mm.description: Nominal cover to the ties (outermost steel)

city.description: Site city; the app derives country, seismic level and code from it

country.description: ISO 3166 code, e.g. "ES". Derived from city when possible

lat.description: Site latitude, e.g. from the photo's GPS; used when no city is given

ductility.description: none/DCL = Eurocode 2 only; DCM/DCH = Eurocode 8 on top

bar_count.description: Bars visible on ONE face, corners included (a 4-bar square column shows 2)

bar_spacing_mm.description: Centre-to-centre spacing of the bars on one face

tie_spacing_mm.description: Tie spacing near the floors (end) and in between (middle)

hook_angle.description: Hook bend at the tie ends

hook_tail_factor.description: Hook tail as a multiple of the tie diameter
